title: Data & AI Opportunities - Qatar
description:
Join Our Growing Data & AI Practice in Qatar

Location: Qatar | Practice Area : Data, AI & Analytics | Type: Permanent

Shape the future of data, analytics and AI with Capco in Qatar.

The Role

Capco is growing our Data & AI practice in Qatar, and we’re looking to connect with talented professionals who want to help organisations unlock greater value from their data. We are hiring Data Architects, Governance, Modelling and Analytics specialists.

You’ll join a collaborative consulting environment where you can work alongside clients and Capco colleagues to solve complex challenges across data, analytics and artificial intelligence. • Work with clients to understand their data, analytics and AI challenges and translate business needs into practical solutions.

• Contribute to the design and delivery of data platforms, analytics capabilities and AI solutions.

• Help clients improve how they manage, govern, access and use data across their organisations.

• Experience working with stakeholders to understand challenges and develop practical solutions.

• Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues and clients from different disciplines and backgrounds.

• An interest in contributing to a growing practice and supporting the development of our Data & AI community.

Bonus Points For

• Experience working within consulting or client-facing environments.

• Knowledge of cloud-based data and analytics platforms.

• Experience delivering data transformation or AI initiatives.

• Experience working within financial services, energy or other regulated industries.

Why Join Capco

• Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.

• Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.

• Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.

Benefits

We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know - we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration - a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

title: Controls Technician
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

xAI is seeking a Controls Technician to support the implementation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of control systems for our data centers and infrastructure. This role involves hands-on work with BMS, EPMS, SCADA systems, PLCs, and other industrial controls to ensure reliable operation of critical systems like cooling, power distribution, and safety protocols. You will collaborate with engineers to maintain automated controls, monitor performance, and respond to operational needs in a fast-paced environment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Assist in the implementation and modification of BMS, EPMS, and SCADA systems for data centers, following engineer specifications.

• Perform routine maintenance and troubleshooting of critical systems (e.g., chillers, pumps, power distribution) using PLCs and industrial control technologies.

• Support the preparation and updating of HMI graphics and interfaces for system monitoring.

• Maintain automated controls for fire safety and emergency shutdown procedures (ESOP).

• Help monitor and report on key metrics like PUE and infrastructure performance via dashboards.

• Coordinate with teams to respond to utility grid events and adjust systems as needed.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Associate's Degree in a technical field (e.g., Controls Technology, Mechatronics, Automation, or equivalent experience).

• 3+ years of hands-on experience as a technician working with industrial control systems.

• Experience with Ignition SCADA or similar programming.

• Familiarity with Siemens TIA Portal or equivalent PLC programming.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Proficiency in troubleshooting industrial equipment using IEC 61131-3 languages (e.g., ladder logic).

• Experience with hardware from Siemens, SEL, Rockwell, or similar.

• Basic knowledge of HMI development tools like Ignition.

• Strong problem-solving skills with a methodical approach.

• Excellent documentation and communication abilities.

• Ability to manage tasks independently in a team environment.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Ability to work extended periods standing, in tight quarters, and exposed to noise.

• Willingness to work evenings and weekends as needed.

• Ability to lift or carry 10-15lbs.

• Subject to pre-employment drug testing and random drug/alcohol testing.

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice .

title: Senior Technical Success Engineer
description:
As a Senior Technical Success Engineer at Backstory, you will own the hardest issues our largest customers raise . You work them from intake to root cause: reading logs, querying live data stores, and establishing a solution. You will have the internal tooling and data access to investigate properly before ever asking a customer to check something you could have checked yourself. You will have the standing to hold a boundary when Sales, Engineering, or the customer pushes for a shortcut.
This is a role for someone who has outgrown the queue and wants the cases that require judgement rather than throughput. Your findings do not stop at case closure: they become documentation, education, product signal, and better escalations for the whole team. This role trends toward full competency at 12-18 months so the first six months here are disorienting by design. Our platform is deep, the data is enormous, and the challenges can be complex and multifactorial. The people who come through become the ones the rest of the company routes its hardest questions to.
What you will do:

• Own complex escalations for strategic accounts end-to-end, without oversight.

• Triage cases at intake as defect, configuration, expectation, or data availability.

• Resolve post-go-live configuration problems that present as product faults; route what belongs to other CSG teams.

• Investigate with internal tooling before contacting the customer, including on surfaces we do not control.

• Diagnose live issues by querying the underlying data stores.

• Present investigation timelines to customers and to internal audiences.

• Carry a full caseload to team standards - 4.5-day time to resolution, 95% SLA without closing cases early to hit them.

• Escalate to Engineering with stakes, timing, and affected-user count attached.

• Hold ticket-quality and escalation standards when asked to bypass them.

• Review AI-generated answers with the Technical KB Manager and improve the source artifacts behind them.

• Submit specific documentation requests to the KB queue; return technical review on drafts within five business days.

• Review teammates' investigations as you grow into the role.

What you will bring:

• Enterprise technical support experience, including at least one support role held for 18 months or more.

• Escalation ownership at a SaaS company whose product moves data between two systems the customer controls.

• A habit of investigating before replying, with specific logs, queries, and consoles you can name.

• The ability to diagnose a production issue with a live query. SQL, SOQL, or equivalent; the reasoning matters more than the dialect.

• Experience holding a written standard under pressure, without conceding a defect or blaming the customer.

• A recurring question you spotted, specified, and saw through to published documentation. Authorship optional.

• Communication that separates the technical answer from the relationship problem and addresses both.

• Nice to have: AI tooling in your own workflow, and a clear account of where it failed and when you stepped back in.

Backstory helps companies understand the state of their revenue business by answering questions that span customer interactions, sales activity, pipeline health, and deal execution. The platform operates over trillions of sales activities, millions of deals, and more than 160 million business contacts, giving customers a unified view of the signals that drive revenue. Companies such as Nvidia, OpenAI, AMD, Red Hat, and Databricks rely on Backstory to surface risks, identify opportunities, and understand what's happening across their business.

Backstory is building AI systems that reason over massive amounts of enterprise data to help business leaders understand what's happening in their business and what to do next. title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer (Golang / Kubernetes)
description:
Define what reliability means for a GPU-accelerated AI platform and make it measurable. You will own the service-level indicators and objectives for the K0rdent Observability Framework (KOF) - deriving meaningful SLIs from the signals the platform already emits, and exposing them to Platform Administrators through a clean API. Work spans hybrid, edge, and air-gapped deployments built on the Mirantis K0rdent stack.
About the Role
We are looking for a Senior SRE who thinks past dashboards to the contract between a platform and its operators. The right candidate can look at raw telemetry from Kubernetes, bare metal, and NVIDIA infrastructure, decide which signals actually predict user-visible reliability, and turn them into SLIs and SLOs that operators can act on. You are equally comfortable writing the service that exposes those SLIs through an API and reasoning about error budgets, alerting quality, and signal-to-noise. You should be self-directed, able to own reliability definitions end to end, and effectively communicate them across teams.
Responsibilities

• Define SLIs and SLOs based on the signals available across the platform - Kubernetes, bare-metal hosts, and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).

• Design and build the API that exposes SLIs and reliability state to Platform Administrators and downstream systems.

• Establish alerting and error-budget practices that maximize signal and minimize noise.

• Partner with infrastructure, storage, and networking teams to ensure the right signals are instrumented and collected.

• Diagnose reliability and performance issues across the observability stack and drive their resolution.

Required Qualifications

• 5+ years in SRE, platform reliability, or a closely related software/infrastructure role.

• Strong software engineering skills (e.g., Go or Python) with experience building and operating APIs or services in production.

• Demonstrated experience defining SLIs/SLOs and error budgets for real production systems.

• Hands-on experience with observability tooling - metrics, logging, and tracing (e.g., Prometheus/VictoriaMetrics, OpenTelemetry, Grafana).

• Solid understanding of Kubernetes and the signals it and its workloads emit.

• Strong written and verbal communication with technical audiences.

Preferred

• Experience instrumenting or monitoring bare-metal and NVIDIA infrastructure (BMC/Redfish, InfiniBand, NVLink, UFM).

• Experience with the Mirantis K0rdent stack (K0rdent Enterprise, K0rdent AI, KOF) and Cluster API.

• Familiarity with VictoriaMetrics/VictoriaLogs at scale.

• Proven experience in sovereign or high-security air-gapped environments.

You’ve worked hard to become the professional you are today and are now ready to take the next step in your career. How will you put your skills, experience and passion to work toward your goals? Observational Research Manager
Live What you will do
Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will be working with multiple teams to generate real world evidence supporting a wide variety of business needs. The increasing demand for real-world evidence (RWE) from regulatory and reimbursement authorities makes observational research a key component of drug development and commercialization. Amgen's Center for Observational Research (CfOR) is a global organization with an industry-leading analytical capability that generates RWE to support business needs across a product’s lifecycle.
CfOR scientists partner with internal team members and industry experts to design, conduct, interpret and publish observational research that informs decision-making from the early development of a molecule to the design of clinical trials and the safety and efficacy of Amgen medicines. title: Principal PLM Configuration Manager
description:
The era of pervasive AI has arrived. In this era, organizations will use generative AI to unlock hidden value in their data, accelerate processes, reduce costs, drive efficiency and innovation to fundamentally transform their businesses and operations at scale.

SambaNova Suite™ is the first full-stack, generative AI platform, from chip to model, optimized for enterprise and government organizations. Powered by the intelligent SN40L chip, the SambaNova Suite is a fully integrated platform, delivered on-premises or in the cloud, combined with state-of-the-art open-source models that can be easily and securely fine-tuned using customer data for greater accuracy. Once adapted with customer data, customers retain model ownership in perpetuity, so they can turn generative AI into one of their most valuable assets.

About the team

The PLM team runs product data and configuration control for our AI systems and semiconductor hardware programs, sitting between Hardware and System Engineering, Silicon, NPI, Manufacturing Engineering, Supply Chain, and Quality. It owns the PLM platform, the change control board, the release schedule against NPI gates, and the EBOM to MBOM handoff into ERP for products spanning silicon, PCBAs, racks, thermal and power subsystems, cables, firmware, and enclosures. The team is small and each person owns a product line end to end, so you will hold decisions rather than route them.

About the role

The PLM Configuration Principal owns product lifecycle and configuration management at the product level - running PLM the way a technical program manager runs a program, not the way a helpdesk runs a ticket queue. This role is the single accountable owner for how a product's data is structured, released, changed, and audited from first schematic through end of life.

It is a dual-hat position. Roughly half is platform ownership: you hold administrator rights in the PLM system and personally configure object models, item and document types, BOM structures, lifecycle phases, change workflows, roles, and privilege masks. The other half is program execution: you chair the change control board, hold the release schedule against NPI gates, keep the EBOM-to-MBOM handoff clean into ERP, and unblock cross-functional decisions across Hardware/System Engineering, Ops PM, Supply Chain, Quality and Contract Manufacturer.

The environment is high-mix, fast-revision AI systems and semiconductor hardware - L5-L12 (silicon, active/passive components, PCBs, PCBAs, racks, thermal and power subsystems, cables, firmware, and mechanical enclosures) - where a single mis-scoped ECO can strand inventory, slip a build, or ship a non-conforming rack. Precision is the job.

Responsibilities

PLM Platform Administration & Configuration (~40%)

• Serve as the named functional administrator for the PLM application - configure and maintain object and subclass models, item and document types, attributes and page-three fields, autonumber schemes, lifecycle phases, revision and effectivity rules, and part numbering standards.

• Build and maintain change workflows (ECR, ECO, ECN, MCO, deviation and waiver, stop-ship, and NCMR routings) including approval matrices, escalation timers, notification rules, and conditional routing logic.

• Administer roles, privilege masks, and criteria-based access controls; enforce least privilege and segregation of duties across internal users, contract manufacturers, ODMs, and foundry or OSAT partners.

• Own the PLM-to-ERP and PLM-adjacent integrations at the functional level: EBOM-to-MBOM transfer, item and AML/AVL synchronization, change-order publication, and reconciliation of failed transactions. Partner with IT on middleware and API-level defects.

• Manage sandbox-to-production promotion, regression testing, patching and upgrade validation, and configuration documentation. Maintain a written configuration baseline of the PLM system itself.

About the Company
Nestify is an established international property management Company that operates in the United Kingdom, France, Ireland and the United Arab Emirates (UAE). The Company is owned, driven, and managed by a group of passionate individuals and a team of highly skilled experts. The Company employs talented individuals from across the globe that drives the success of the business.
The Company is the preferred Airbnb rental management partner for many international property owners, providing a higher letting income for short-, medium- and long-term stays. As a tech-driven company, the Company provides a round-the-clock contactless service, ensuring customers worldwide can enjoy the stay they deserve. From booking to check-out, housekeeping, and maintenance, Nestify takes care of everything and ensures a seamless experience for all Clients and Guests.
About the Position
The 360° Senior Sales Executive (Property Acquisition) is responsible for driving property growth and taking full, end-to-end ownership of the sales cycle within our target markets. In this role, you will do the legwork of prospecting new leads, converting inbound landlord inquiries, reactivating dormant pipeline opportunities, and cultivating strategic local B2B referral networks.
While you will work alongside a supportive team, this role requires a self-managed closer who thrives on taking total accountability for their pipeline. You must be comfortable navigating high-stakes, difficult conversations and overcoming tough objections to close deals.
The 360° Senior Sales Executive reports to the Sales Manager and plays a pivotal role in accelerating Nestify ’s revenue and property portfolio.
Duties and Responsibilities

• End-to-End Sales Ownership: Manage the complete, 360° sales lifecycle from initial prospecting and discovery calls to contract issuance and deal execution.

• Inbound Lead Conversion: Pitch, negotiate, and close pre-booked landlord inquiries generated via the website and SDR team.

• Proactive Prospecting & Re-Engagement: Conduct cold/warm outreach to hunt for new opportunities and reactivate non-converted, dormant accounts.

• B2B Partnership Development: Identify, contact, and build direct referral relationships with local real estate brokers, property managers, developers, and financial advisors in the target market.

• Objection Handling & Negotiation: Confidently lead high-stakes, complex conversations and resolve client objections while maintaining deal momentum to achieve high close rates.

• CRM & Pipeline Management: Maintain meticulous CRM hygiene, tracking all outreach activity, contract statuses, pipeline stages, and conversion metrics.

What We Are Looking For

• Minimum 5+ years of full-cycle, end-to-end sales experience in direct B2B or consultative service selling.

• Proven track record of closing phone-based or remote agreements and handling tough, high-stakes negotiations independently.

• Strong outbound discipline and willingness to roll up your sleeves for cold outreach and prospecting legwork.

• High cultural agility with experience selling to or working with clients in the UK or international markets.

• Fluent written and spoken English to a professional C1/C2 standard.

• Highly organized, resilient, and self-motivated to meet targets with minimal supervision.

• Direct background or domain experience in real estate, property management, or short-term rentals is a plus, but not required.

Working Days and Hours

• Monday to Friday

• 09:00 to 18:00 (Target Market Local Time)

• Location: Remote (South Africa for UK Market)

• Schedule: Full-Time

What Nestify Offers

• Competitive base salary with an attractive performance commission structure.

• Work in a global team of highly motivated and talented individuals.

• Generous leave entitlement.

• A company culture that values loyalty, hard work, dedication, high performance, and work-life balance.

• Autonomous environment with strong opportunities to grow

• Other duties as required

• Intermediate level understanding of insurance payer/provider claims processing and subsequent data requirements.

• Intermediate level understanding of Medicaid payers preferred.

title: Senior AI Trainer
description:
Role Title: Senior AI Trainer
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Senior AI Trainers to collaborate on a customer-driven project enhancing AI system accuracy through expert-level video annotation and data labeling. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input.
Key Responsibilities:

• Review video footage of robotic arms executing assigned tasks, identifying key actions and outcomes with precision.

• Apply detailed grading guidelines to accurately tag and annotate events, providing structured observations that improve model performance.

• Mark precise timestamps for the start and end of key actions, transitions, and outcomes, ensuring frame-accurate segmentation of each video session.

• Verify timestamp accuracy and alignment across annotations, correcting drift or inconsistencies between labeled events and the underlying footage.

• Utilize video annotation tools and platforms to record findings and submit annotated datasets in alignment with project standards and milestones.

• Collaborate with project trainers and contributors to resolve ambiguities, refine guidelines, and ensure annotation consistency across the team.

• Participate in ongoing quality reviews, incorporating feedback to maintain rigorous annotation standards.

Required Skills and Qualifications:

• Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy in reviewing and tagging visual data.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills for effective collaboration, reporting, and timely updates on progress and challenges.

• Demonstrated time management and self-organization abilities for independent, remote project participation.

• Analytical and problem-solving mindset, with a proactive approach to resolving annotation challenges.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Proven experience with video annotation, data labeling, or similar data-centric annotation projects.

• Familiarity with video annotation tools and software platforms, including timeline-based interfaces for timestamping and event segmentation.

• Experience with frame-level or timecode-based annotation (e.g., marking event boundaries, working with frame rates, or reviewing footage frame by frame).

• Background in AI training, machine learning data preparation, or robotics projects (strongly preferred).

This role partners closely with Wealth Management Advisors (WMAs), Commercial Relationship Managers, and Investment Banking partners to lead discovery, develop integrated wealth and business transition strategies, and support implementation across pre- and post-transaction phases.
The role contributes directly to client acquisition, retention, and overall client experience by delivering comprehensive planning solutions that align business transition outcomes with personal wealth, estate, and tax objectives.
Please see below for specific responsibilities and requirements for this role.
YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES:
The responsibilities for this role are below; you may support projects of varying complexity based on skill and organizational priorities.

• Client & Prospect Engagement: Partner with WMAs and One Bank partners to acquire and retain key client relationships by delivering comprehensive wealth strategies, with a focus on business owners and transition opportunities.

• Business Transition Discovery & Planning: Work directly with business owners to assess transition readiness, identify key risks and opportunities, and develop customized transition strategies spanning pre- and post-transaction phases.

• Integrated Wealth & Business Strategy: Align business transition plans with personal wealth strategies, including estate planning, tax optimization, liquidity planning, and legacy goals.

• Wealth Planning Strategy: Lead development of integrated wealth plans across estate, tax, investment, risk, insurance, and cash flow planning disciplines.

• Research & Modeling: Identify planning opportunities and model financial and tax implications of business transition scenarios, including sale, transfer, or recapitalization strategies.

• Client Deliverables & Oversight: Coordinate preparation and review of client deliverables, including transition plans, financial models, and presentations.

• Strategy Implementation: Present recommendations and coordinate execution of transition and wealth planning strategies in partnership with internal and external advisors.

• Partnership & One Bank Coordination: Lead a coordinated team approach across Wealth Management, Commercial, and Investment Banking partners to deliver a seamless client experience.

• Thought Leadership & Education: Educate internal partners and clients on business transition strategies, trends, and considerations through presentations, materials, and external engagement.

• Leadership & Talent Development: Coach and mentor Analysts and Strategists to build capabilities in advanced planning and business transition advisory.

• Risk & Compliance: Operate within the Bank’s risk framework and ensure adherence to policies and procedures while acting in the best interests of clients and colleagues.

• Other Duties: Performing other duties as assigned, adapting to new tasks or shifts in priorities as necessary to support your team’s and the company’s mission.

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• Bachelor’s degree required.

• 10+ years of experience in wealth planning, business advisory, investment banking, legal, accounting, or related professional services environment supporting business owners.

REQUIRED SKILLS:
Qualified candidates will possess an advanced degree of proficiency (typically from 10+ years of experience), in:

• Wealth & Transition Planning Expertise: Advanced knowledge of estate, tax, investment, and business transition planning concepts.

• Client Advisory Skills: Strong consultative approach with excellent communication and presentation capabilities.

title: Head of Technical Support
description:

WE’RE MAKING TRAVEL EFFORTLESS. JOIN US.

Travel is essential, whether it’s visiting family, starting a new adventure, or taking a career defining trip. Yet today, over 4 billion airline passengers rely on tech that hasn't changed in decades.

At Duffel, we’re rebuilding the infrastructure underpinning the global travel industry. Backed by top-tier investors (Benchmark, Blossom, Index Ventures, and Kima Ventures) and born out of Y Combinator (S18), we’re simplifying complex systems to build the future of travel

About the role

As Head of Technical Support, you’ll lead our team of Technical Support Engineers and take responsibility for the quality, effectiveness and development of the function.

You’ll build a team that combines strong technical investigation with clear, thoughtful customer communication. You’ll coach engineers, establish effective ways of working and ensure customers receive dependable support as their integrations grow in complexity and scale.

You’ll stay close to the work: reviewing investigations, helping with significant escalations and understanding where our products or processes create friction. Your impact will come from strengthening the whole team’s ability to resolve problems and turning what we learn from support into lasting improvements.

You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product, Partner Engineering, Partner Management and Travel Operations. Technical Support owns day-to-day API questions, troubleshooting and the customer support response to technical incidents. - Build a dependable support operation. Improve triage, prioritisation, queue management, handovers and escalation paths. Plan staffing and coverage around customer needs and agreed service commitments, with a sustainable workload for the team.

- Strengthen technical capability. Help engineers investigate API behaviour, interpret logs and request traces, reproduce integration issues and distinguish customer configuration problems from platform or supplier issues.

- Lead significant customer escalations. Coordinate the support response, establish customer impact and keep communication clear through to resolution. Work with Engineering on diagnosis and recovery, involving Partner Engineering where an issue creates a wider strategic risk.

- Make collaboration effective. Give Engineering actionable escalation reports with evidence, reproduction steps and impact. Work with Travel Operations on booking and supplier issues, and with implementation teams to ensure new integrations enter support with the context the team needs.

- Improve the product through support. Identify recurring problems and turn them into clear recommendations for Product and Engineering. Track whether fixes, documentation and product changes actually reduce customer friction.

- Make support easier to deliver. Develop troubleshooting guides, internal knowledge, customer documentation and useful tooling. Apply automation and AI where they improve accuracy, speed and access to help.

- Use evidence to guide decisions. Monitor response and resolution performance, ageing work, reopened cases, customer feedback and team capacity. Use that information to prioritise improvements and make clear recommendations about investment.

What we’re looking for

- Experience managing and developing a technical support or support engineering

title: Backend Engineer - Coverage Team
description:
***For that position, we only hire in Buenos Aires🇦🇷 or Sao Paulo🇧🇷***
Who is Rollee

Rollee is a data platform that helps financial institutions make better risk decisions by accessing verified income, employment, and other alternative data directly from the source.
The way people work has changed. Income can now come from multiple employers, freelance work, gig platforms, or other sources, but many financial institutions still rely on traditional documents and credit data to understand someone's financial situation. This can make verification slow and fragmented and can leave people with non-traditional income profiles underserved.
Through a single platform, we connect to sources such as gig platforms, government tax portals, payment platforms, and other employment and income systems, then transform that information into structured, actionable data. Our customers use it to verify income and employment, improve their risk models, reduce fraud, and make better underwriting decisions.
Ultimately, our mission is to help build a financial system where people can be assessed based on a more complete picture of their real financial situation, regardless of how or where they work.
The role
We’re looking for a Backend Engineer to join our Coverage team.
The Coverage team is responsible for expanding and maintaining Rollee ’s ability to connect to employment and income data sources. You’ll work on challenging technical problems involving web and mobile applications, third-party systems, APIs, authentication flows, and data extraction.
We’re open to different levels of experience. You might be a junior engineer looking for an environment where you can learn quickly and take on increasing responsibility, or a more experienced engineer ready to own problems independently and contribute to technical decisions.
What matters most to us is your curiosity, problem-solving ability, and willingness to understand how systems work under the hood.
What you'll do

• Build, maintain, and improve integrations with employment and income data sources

• Investigate and resolve production issues

• Explore web and mobile applications to understand how they communicate with backend systems

• Work with undocumented or partially documented third-party APIs

• Debug authentication flows, network requests, and data extraction processes

• Write reliable, maintainable Python code

• Contribute to technical design decisions and help improve our engineering practices

• Improve the testing, monitoring, and automation of our systems

• Collaborate closely with engineers, Product Managers, Data Scientists, and other members of the team

• Take ownership of your work, iterate quickly, learn from feedback, and continuously improve

The scope and level of ownership will naturally depend on your experience.
What we're looking for
We’d love to hear from you if you have:

• Experience with Python

• Experience with web scraping, automation, data extraction, or similar technical challenges

• A good understanding of HTTP, APIs, and client-server communication

• Some experience exploring or debugging web and/or mobile applications

• The ability and curiosity to investigate systems with limited or incomplete documentation

• A strong problem-solving mindset and an interest in understanding how things work

• The ability to learn independently and get comfortable with unfamiliar technical challenges

• Good written and spoken English

We’re intentionally open to different experience levels, so you don’t need to tick every box. If you have strong technical foundations and enjoy solving unconventional engineering problems, we encourage you to apply.
Nice to have
Any of the following would be a plus:

• Experience with network debugging and traffic analysis

• Knowledge of authentication and authorization mechanisms

• Familiarity with application security, encryption, and common security protocols

• Experience reverse-engineering web or mobile application behavior

title: Product Engineer (Platform)
description:
Are you a product-minded backend engineer who enjoys turning customer problems into reliable platform capabilities? Join Chainstack and help make blockchain infrastructure easier to provision, operate, and scale.
About us
Chainstack powers global blockchain applications across fintech, DeFi, wallets, custodians, analytics, and everything in between. Teams cut time-to-market, cost, and risk with one platform for nodes in the cloud, offered through preferred service providers, or self-hosted. Standardized node management puts reliability on autopilot and keeps performance predictable, giving operators control and transparency while developers get a consistent way to build and scale.
About the role
We're looking for a Product Engineer to own customer and business problems end-to-end behind blockchain infrastructure: understand the opportunity, shape the solution, ship it, measure the outcome, and keep improving it in production. You'll work across backend services, infrastructure workflows, developer experience, and customer-facing product, partnering with product, platform, DevOps, support, and sales to turn real customer and operational needs into simple, scalable products.
This is a product-first role. Strong product judgment and end-to-end backend ownership are the core. Platform and infra depth (Kubernetes, IaC, on-call) is a strong plus, not a gate. We care that you understand what customers are trying to do, how your decisions move revenue, retention, adoption, and support load, and how to turn that into shipped work.
Responsibilities

• Own product initiatives end to end: from problem definition through spec, build, rollout, measurement, and iteration.

• Turn ambiguous customer and operational problems (provisioning, reliability, scalability, observability, deployment, pricing, usage) into clear plans and measurable outcomes.

• Build backend services, APIs, internal tools, and customer-facing capabilities that make blockchain infrastructure easier to provision, operate, and scale.

• Spot friction, reliability risks, scaling limits, and missed opportunities, then drive practical fixes from concept to production.

• Define and improve the metrics that matter: activation, adoption, provisioning time, deployment success rate, operational cost, incident frequency, support volume, retention.

• Use AI across the workflow (research, specs, implementation, testing, analysis) to move faster, with a high bar for verifying what it produces.

• Work across product, engineering, DevOps, support, and sales, and communicate decisions, trade-offs, and risks clearly in writing.

Requirements

• 5+ years of software engineering, ideally in backend, product, platform, or distributed systems roles.

• A track record of owning projects end to end: discovery, design, build, test, deploy, measure, iterate.

• Strong product sense. You connect technical work to customer value, commercial impact, and measurable outcomes.

• Solid backend experience building production services, APIs, and integrations in a modern language.

• Real understanding of distributed systems, asynchronous and event-driven architecture, and the reliability trade-offs.

We are hiring a mid-level Systems Engineer to take hands-on ownership of Infiterra ’s internal IT environment. The role combines Microsoft 365 and Entra ID administration, endpoint and systems management, employee IT support, access and security controls, and automation.
Your mission is to provide secure, reliable and increasingly automated corporate IT services to Infiterra employees. You will own day-to-day corporate IT operations while improving automation, identity and access management, endpoint management, employee lifecycle processes and service quality.
Moreover, you will have the opportunity to help evolve the function from largely operational support into a standardized, secure and increasingly automated internal IT service. • Keep licensing spend, permissions and integrations accurate and well documented, so there's never confusion about who owns what.

• Grow a knowledge base that resolves issues faster over time, instead of solving them from memory each time.

• Fix recurring issues at the root, so ticket volume trends down instead of repeating.

Security & Compliance Operations

• Keep access evidence, endpoint compliance, asset inventories and account lifecycle records ready to hand over for an ISO 27001 or SOC 2 audit.

• Run IT controls reliably day to day, giving Security confidence in the operational layer without having to manage it themselves.

Ideal Candidate Profile

• A Systems Engineer with hands-on Internal IT operations experience, comfortable across Microsoft

On ne cherche pas quelqu'un qui exécute. On cherche un partenaire créatif qui comprend que chaque scroll est une bataille, que chaque hook a 3 secondes pour gagner, et que chaque euro dépensé en ads doit revenir multiplié.

title: Business Information Architect
description:
Your team’s dynamic:
The Information Architecture, Intelligence & Analytics, or IAIA for short, is part of the broader Genetec Offerings & Transformation department that is tasked with managing some of the major lT transformation projects within our organization. IAIA is responsible for designing and managing data architecture and warehousing solutions, analyzing and interpreting data for insights, and developing BI solutions-including dashboards, reports, KPIs, and data models-to transform raw data into actionable intelligence for strategic and operational decision-making.
The goal of the Business Information Architect is to define the overall structure, standards, and integration of data systems to ensure that data is organized, accessible, and aligned with business needs.
One of the goals of the Genetec Offerings & Transformation team is to enable higher quality operational readiness and support throughout the enterprise. Through an investment in technology, talent, and business transformation initiatives, the team aims to continuously strengthen Genetec ’s position as a leader.
Genetec is looking for an experienced Information Analyst to join our dynamic and growing team. In this critical role, the successful candidate will play a pivotal role in bridging the gap between our business objectives and technology capabilities. They will be tasked with gathering and documenting business Information requirements from stakeholders, translating these into technical specifications, and liaising with the Digital Information department to ensure alignment.
The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in both business analysis and information analysis, with a strong ability to dissect complex data, recognize trends, and communicate impactful insights in a clear and concise manner. Strong analytical skills, excellent communication abilities, and a keen understanding of both business needs and IT capabilities are essential for this position. The role offers a fantastic opportunity to influence strategy and growth in our fast-paced, innovative company.
The role is a vital part of the IAIA team, bridging the gap between concept and execution.
Your day at a glance:

• Engage with stakeholders at all levels to deeply understand the organization's data requirements, decision-making processes, and key metrics

• Translate business information needs into technical specifications and work with the Business Architect, Data Analyst and BI team to ensure they understand and can meet these requirements

• Design how information should be structured, captured, accessed and flow across various systems (CRM, ERP, marketing, operations, etc.) to support reporting and analytics

• Work closely with BI developers, data analysts, data engineers, and business units to ensure technical design meets business goals

• Establish policies for data quality, security, privacy, and lifecycle management; maintain metadata and data catalogs

• Establish and enforce naming conventions, modeling standards, and architectural documentation practices

• Manage and enhance the company's data and information security protocols to ensure compliance with relevant standards

• Assist in driving the design and enhancement of our Business Intelligence tools, databases, dashboards, systems, or methods

• Act as a liaison between the business units and Digital Information department, ensuring that solutions meet business needs

• Develop communication packages in conjunction with Transformation team. Documents may include Playbooks, Transition Guides, FAQs, etc.

• Performs other duties as directed by leadership

• Can drive a cross functional group of business functions towards a common goal

• Can multi-task across several simultaneous product launches

• Thrive on ambiguity

What makes you a great fit:

• Bachelors in business, Information Systems, Statistics, Computer Science, or related field. Master's degree preferred.

• TOGAF Certificate (Enterprise Architecture)

OMH will work with you to identify the best “fit” and will provide everything you need to treat OMH patients remotely from the comfort of your home. Our interview process focuses on your skill sets, interest as well as geographic location to match you to the best available option to begin working with OMH. Of course, if you prefer to work from home, we also have fully remote positions available.

Outpatient behavioral health practices like OMH are getting more attention than ever before due to the emphasis on team approaches. Join OMH to perfect your skills in the emerging field of integrated behavioral health care. The interdisciplinary health care team includes physicians, psychiatric nurse practitioners, licensed clinical psychologists, and licensed mental health professionals (LCSW/LPC/LMFT/LMHP). OMH values clinical relationships between all provider levels and believes this coordinated, collaborative approach provides the highest level of care to the patients we are privileged to serve.

Customize the care for each patient:

Our clinicians have the unique ability to customize the care for each and every individual patient. You will have the autonomy to determine how often you see a patient as well as the appropriate length of time spent with each patient. Medication management and individual psychotherapy are the most common forms of clinical work performed at OMH, but our clinicians also perform family therapy, group therapy, and psychological testing as needed and/or appropriate to a wide range of presenting problems of our patients.

Pick your own schedule!

• Enjoy the freedom to create your own custom schedules with the perfect work/life balance.

Hospitals, community clinics, investment bank funded group practice startups, state agencies, and more.

At OptiMindHealth , we continuously strive to provide consistent, high-quality care and expand the reach of mental health care services in our communities. To combat this crisis and further our mission, we need more compassionate and skilled clinicians to join our cause. By investing in your growth, supporting you financially, holistically, and professionally, while being flexible regarding your personal needs and goals. Our administrative support team handles all non-clinical tasks so that you don’t have to think about anything except focusing on your patients.

title: Data Scientist, Experimentation
description:
About Tripadvisor

The Tripadvisor Group connects people to experiences worth sharing, and aims to be the world’s most trusted source for travel and experiences. We leverage our brands, technology, and capabilities to connect our global audience with partners through rich content, travel guidance, and two-sided marketplaces for experiences, accommodations, restaurants, and other travel categories. The subsidiaries of Tripadvisor, Inc. (Nasdaq: TRIP), include a portfolio of travel brands and businesses, including Tripadvisor, Viator, and TheFork.

At Tripadvisor experiences, the only thing we love more than travel is data. We slice it, we dice it, and we use it to empower our decision making.

 

What You will do:

As a Data Scientist on our experimentation team you will work with product teams across Viator to measure whether the changes they ship actually worked, defining the metrics that matter and making sure the decisions that follow are sound.

Part of your contribution is making experimentation easier for the teams you support, through reusable tooling, clear documentation and consistent practice. Viator sells experiences that travellers often book once a year, in a marketplace where supply is finite and shared, so you will be learning to navigate problems where the obvious analysis can give the wrong answer, with support from senior practitioners who have done it before.

You will:

• Design and analyse experiments end to end with the product teams you support, working directly with the Product Managers and Engineers who will act on the results.

• Turn product questions into testable hypotheses with pre-registered primary metrics, appropriate guardrails, and an honest view of what the available traffic can and cannot detect before the experiment starts.

• Define and instrument feature-level metrics, understanding how metric choice affects sensitivity, interpretation and the decision a team is trying to make.

• Investigate results properly, checking assignment integrity, exposure and data quality before conclusions are drawn, and treating a surprising result as something to diagnose rather than announce.

• Build reusable queries, tooling and templates and apply our shared protocols, so teams can run good experiments faster and with less rework.

• Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including inconclusive and negative results, with a recommendation attached rather than a table of numbers.

• Look beyond whether a change worked to why it worked, and flag when a result may not hold for other users, markets or time periods.

• Carry out analysis beyond experiments, including opportunity sizing, funnel and behavioural analysis, and observational measurement where randomisation isn't possible.

• Document hypotheses, designs, outcomes and decisions so results remain comparable and the organisation compounds what it learns.

• Grow your own depth in experimentation and causal inference, with review and mentorship from senior and principal data scientists.

 

Skills & Experience

 

• Experience: Solid experience in data science or a similar quantitative role, supporting and influencing product teams.

• Statistical & Experimentation Foundations: Sound understanding of experimentation beyond running it through a platform, including statistical power and minimum detectable effect, the difference between an inconclusive result and no effect, why peeking and post-hoc metric selection cause problems, and the common ways an experiment can be invalid.

• Technical & Modelling Expertise: Strong proficiency in Python and SQL, with hands-on experience of statistical analysis and experimentation, and some exposure to statistical modelling or machine learning techniques such as regression and classification.

title: Mental Health Therapist - Washington
description:
About NOCD

NOCD is the #1 telehealth provider for the treatment of obsessive-compulsive disorder (OCD). OCD is one of the most severe, prevalent, and misunderstood mental health conditions. NOCD creates access to online therapy for people with OCD through our telehealth platform. In the NOCD app, Members can quickly access and schedule live, face-to-face video therapy sessions with our national network of licensed Therapists that specialize in Exposure and Response Prevention Therapy (ERP) - considered the "gold standard" in OCD treatment.

At NOCD , we help people reclaim their lives with clinically proven OCD treatment, by removing barriers to OCD care, and reducing the stigma associated with OCD. We’re changing the world and need other like-minded individuals to accelerate and expand our efforts.

About the Role

As the specialist virtual behavioral health provider, at NOCD , we want our Therapists to focus on what's most important - treating and caring for our members.

NOCD is looking for Independently Licensed Therapists ( LMHC, LMFT, LICSW or Licensed Psychologists) in Washington State to join our team.

As a NOCD Therapist, you will see our team is committed to achieving clinical excellence, an exquisite Therapist experience and providing proven & visible clinical outcomes. We have dedicated teams to handle your marketing, billing, credentialing, and scheduling. Therapists will use valuable previous clinical experience, good judgment, and our clinical guidelines to discern when to refer members to external resources.

You'll enjoy growth and support through: ongoing consultation with other team members; specialized clinical training with experienced OCD providers; information on the latest research advancements in the field; technical support and clinical protocols; 1:1 mentorship to discuss complex cases; and an open, receptive environment to provide feedback.

What You'll Do

• Help people with OCD get better and stay better by providing top-notch care through diagnoses, assessments, and evidence-based psychotherapy via the NOCD video platform

• Manage your caseload and schedule

• Collaborate with our network of providers to help develop and reinforce treatment decisions

Requirements:

•

• Open and willing to treat children and adolescents after attending NOCD Child and Adolescent training

• Practical experience independently diagnosing is required for this role (this practical experience can be during your pre-licensed experience).

•

• If you do not have this direct practical experience, proof of completion (with certificate) of the following training will be accepted in its place: Tolin & Diamond Training Video.

• Please note: submission of proof of completion does not guarantee hire, NOCD will not reimburse the cost of this course.

Who You Are

• Full and unrestricted license in good standing to practice in your state.

•

• At least 6 months of relevant experience with evidence-based therapies (e.g., ERP, CBT, ACT)

title: QA Inspektor
description:
Kvalita u nás není jen kolonka v tabulce. Je to jistota, že zákazník dostane přesně takové potraviny, jaké by si sám vybral v obchodě.

Do našeho týmu proto hledáme kolegu nebo kolegyni, který/á bude přímo ve skladu hlídat kvalitu zboží - od chvíle, kdy k nám dorazí, během jeho skladování až po cestu k zákazníkovi.

Pokud máš dobré oko pro detail, jsi pečlivý/á a nebojíš se říct, když něco není v pořádku, tahle práce by Ti mohla sednout. Předchozí zkušenosti z kvality jsou výhodou, ale důležitější je pro nás spolehlivost, zodpovědnost a chuť dělat věci pořádně.

Co Tě u nás čeká

- Budeš kontrolovat kvalitu zboží při příjmu a hlídat, zda odpovídá našim standardům.

- Průběžně zkontroluješ produkty také během skladování a oddělíš zboží, které požadovanou kvalitu nesplňuje.

- Výsledky kontrol budeš jednoduše zaznamenávat, aby bylo vždy dohledatelné, co a kdy se kontrolovalo.

- Pokud narazíš na problém, předáš ho nadřízenému a pomůžeš s jeho řešením.

- Budeš se podílet na zavádění nápravných opatření, aby se stejné problémy zbytečně neopakovaly.

- Čeká Tě práce přímo v provozu skladu, včetně chladírenských prostor.

Hodíš se k nám, pokud:

- máš smysl pro detail a přesnost,

- je na tebe spoleh a umíš dodržovat nastavené postupy,

- dokážeš jasně komunikovat a upozornit na problém,

- nevadí Ti směnný provoz,

- zvládneš práci ve skladovém prostředí včetně chladnějších prostor,

- poradíš si s mobilem, aplikacemi a jednoduchým zadáváním dat,

- a umíš fungovat jako součást týmu.

Co je výhodou, ale ne podmínkou

- SŠ vzdělání v oblasti potravinářství, zemědělství nebo příbuzném oboru.

- Zkušenost ze skladu, maloobchodu, potravinářské výroby nebo kontroly kvality.

- Základní znalost angličtiny.

Co Ti nabízíme:

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupování s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Možnost placeného volna - čas na pořádný odpočinek a regeneraci.

- Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma - dobré jídlo, skvělá káva a čerstvé ovoce přímo na pracovišti každý den.

- Příspěvek na ošatné - 86 Kč navíc ke každé odpracované směně.

- Systém odměn za pochvaly - sbírání hvězdiček od kolegů a jejich výměna za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Multisport karta - příspěvek na sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

- Fajn firemní akce - společné oslavy úspěchů a neformální večírky.

Proč právě tahle práce?

Výsledek svojí práce uvidíš každý den. Pomáháš rozhodovat o tom, jaké zboží se dostane až k zákazníkovi. Když něco není v pořádku, máš možnost to zachytit dřív, než produkt opustí sklad.

Hledáme někoho, komu záleží na tom, aby věci byly udělané správně - protože právě díky takovým lidem můžeme zákazníkům doručovat potraviny v kvalitě, kterou od Rohlíku očekávají.

description:
Expert Animal Husbandry
As an expert in the Animal Husbandry programme, you understand the crucial role livestock plays in food security, income generation, and the sustainable development of local communities. You bring proven experience with livestock production and animal feed systems, as well as technical knowledge of animal health and production. Are you ready to drive change within the Animal Husbandry programme worldwide and make a real impact? This is your opportunity!
About PUM
PUM is a unique NGO committed to making a positive impact on a global scale. With a network of 1,200 skilled voluntary experts, we collaborate with ambitious entrepreneurs in 26 countries and 12 programmes, sharing expertise to strengthen business ecosystems and create economic, social, and environmental value. We work closely with small and medium-sized enterprises, as well as the organisations that support them. We believe in the power of collaboration and in the magic that happens when diverse perspectives come together; Together we grow!
Who are you?

•
You have a track record of relevant experience in animal husbandry , for example:

• ruminant livestock in tropical climates;

• animal feed production , preferably with an expertise in animal nutrition and food processing technology;

• You are an authentic, resilient, humble and dynamic professional.

• You appreciate cultural differences and interact with equality and respect.

• You are eager to operate as a sparring partner in culturally diverse and changing circumstances.

• You are hands-on and can translate knowledge into a practical plan.

• You have excellent command of the English language, both verbally and in writing. Bonus points for French or Spanish proficiency!

• You are comfortable with digital tools, including Microsoft Office 365.

As an expert at PUM , you play a key role. By sharing your knowledge and experience you’re empowering the sustainable growth of SMEs in countries worldwide. You’re not just an expert - you’re a change maker!
The role
Your application is for a place in our pool of experts for the animal husbandry programme, not for a specific project. Once you've joined, you will be matched with up to three projects per year, either on location or remotely. Around one in three projects will be delivered as remote advice, though working solely on remote advisory projects is also possible.
On location, you’ll spend two weeks on-site with the client. PUM covers your flight and visa, while the client takes care of your accommodation, meals, and local transportation. You will also receive an expense allowance.
As PUM expert you not only share knowledge, you also:

• Empower entrepreneurs, supporting their journey toward sustainable and inclusive business development.

• Leave a lasting impact on the community: socially, environmentally, and economically.

• Turn your knowledge into a hands-on project plan.

• Expand your horizons at sector days and building a network that’s as diverse as it gets.

Eligibility and Requirements
The expert role is a voluntary position. You can apply up to and including the calendar year in which you turn 69. PUM engages experts who reside in the Netherlands, are registered in the Municipal Personal Records Database (BRP), and have Dutch basic health insurance. Prescreening (VOG) is part of the selection process. At PUM , we celebrate diversity and inclusion as essential pillars of our organisation. We embrace the uniqueness of each individual to foster an environment where everyone can thrive by being their authentic selves.

By becoming a PUM expert, you’re not just stepping into a new role; you’re becoming a catalyst for positive change. It’s a two-way street of knowledge exchange that makes a global impact. Here’s what’s in it for you:

HOLOPLOT deployed Matrix Arrays in various venues, including the Sphere in Las Vegas - the world’s most advanced entertainment venue and, notably, home to the world’s largest audio installation in entertainment.  Audio processing in HOLOPLOT systems is distributed: every loudspeaker runs embedded Linux, and hundreds of them have to be configured, coordinated, monitored, and updated as one system. This is enabled by multiple open source and in-house developed services running on an on-premises Kubernetes cluster. AWS-hosted services connect venues to remote monitoring, telemetry, and configuration. Many venues are air-gapped or only intermittently connected for remote servicing, and that constraint shapes most of the design decisions in the platform.
